Author: hiarc
Name: Ostinato
Description: Swaps the pressed action for the next step of your rotation, using per-job rules you can switch on and off.
TestingChangelog:
Test build for PR #23: M119–M124 + M131: test rigs, dev tooling, convert stack out of the DLL, old config shapes and named stacks removed, GC-settled alloc gates (cleanup S8–S9)

1. Named stacks are removed (they have had no editor since an earlier release). An old config that still assigns one shows a single warning, and that action uses its own stack.
2. A config from a very old release (0.1.0.7 or earlier) is no longer converted: settings start from defaults and the old file is kept beside it.
3. When a config has to be reset, the backup copy is now named after the version it came from, e.g. `Ostinato.json.v2.bak`.

Minor: about 1,500 lines of offline-only code (the capture converter) leave the plugin DLL; a large internal cleanup of tests and dev tooling.
